scenes.headline: How FinFIRST grades where a finance answer came from
scenes.sub: And what Ling-3.0-flash-Fin, the model shipped beside it, actually is
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Biscotti! inclusionAI shipped a finance model, Ling-3.0-flash-Fin, and a benchmark that checks where an agent's numbers came from. Let's open both.

scenes.text: A financial answer is a number tied to an entity, a period, a unit and a source. FinFIRST grades each link, not just the number.
scenes.say: The idea: a financial answer is a number tied to an entity, a period, a unit and a source. FinFIRST grades each link, not just the number.

items.say: Each of a hundred and twenty-three tasks asks for a sourced figure, like Meta's share of US social media ad revenue.

items.text: Split the answer into atomic checks
items.say: Its reference solution is split into atomic criteria, seven hundred and one across the set, each a yes-or-no check.
Each is tagged: finding the raw data, verifying the source, or computing the answer.

items.text: A judge model grades every check
items.say: A judge model grades every check. Against eight finance professionals, it agreed at a kappa of point eight one six.
Strict Pass counts a task only when every one of its checks passes.

scenes.title: Where the 124B comes from
scenes.say: And the model? It's Ling-3.0-flash with more financial training, its tensors byte for byte the same shapes. So what does one twenty-four billion count?

parts.say: The forty-two-layer backbone is one twenty-four point four one billion. That's the announced number.
One extra layer rides along: a multi-token prediction head of three point oh seven billion.

parts.note: every tensor, summed across all 65 shards
parts.say: Together, every tensor in all sixty-five shards.

scenes.title: FinFIRST source verification, weighted pass rate
scenes.note: fourth of 15 overall, first of the nine open-weight models
scenes.say: On source verification, the Fin model scores eighty-two point four five. Fourth of fifteen overall, and first among the nine open-weight models.

scenes.text: Grading how an agent reached a number catches failures a final-answer grader can't see.
scenes.mark: how an agent reached a number

recap: Same tensors as Ling-3.0-flash, more finance training
124B is the backbone, without the MTP head
FinFIRST grades 701 atomic checks across 123 tasks
scenes.say: To recap: an unchanged architecture, a parameter count that adds up, and a benchmark that grades the sourcing, not just the answer.
